host.period_status: Joint two-family timing fit after ASAS-SN and ZTF independently selected 38 orbital cycles between TESS visits.
host.claim_basis: earlier public machine or TESS pipeline detection
host.prior_evidence: Kostov et al. (2025), machine-selected Table 2, and a TESS threshold-crossing event. No earlier vetted same-clock eclipse identification was found in the sources searched.
host.interpretation: Two discrete eclipse families recur at phases 0 and 0.2297. Difference images favor this star in 2 sectors for the epoch-defining family and 2 for the second. Neither family has an unresolved flux-capable Gaia neighbour in these fits. The two TESS visits are 760.24 days apart. Ground photometry distinguishes 20.0062 days from the remaining TESS timing aliases. The epoch-defining eclipse is shallower.
